# Meet the inputs

::: {.callout-important}
This real-study section is a scaffold. No real dataset or real findings are bundled yet.
:::

Before creating `data/real-study/summary-statistics.tsv`, record the original citation, study accession, file URL, access date, license, checksum, phenotype, population descriptors, sample size, build, effect units and model.

Keep the original source files outside the prepared folder. Map their columns in a reproducible importer. Check whether source p-values are Wald, score, likelihood-ratio, mixed-model or another test; do not replace them by beta/SE-derived values.

Document whether N is actual or effective sample size, and whether a quality metric is INFO, R² or something else. Missing columns may require extending the importer/workflow, rather than filling defaults.
